title: BUPT volleyball · university & college teams
description: I love volleyball and the exhilaration it brings. It has been a constant throughout my university life. After starting university, I joined both the university and college volleyball teams within a week. Since then, I have represented BUPT in multiple competitions in Beijing and, alongside my college teammates, won campus championships for our college several times.
role: Player on the university and college volleyball teams
